name: Protect Closet Shelving — Full Cover
intent: Heavy protection: full plastic wrap + taped perimeter. Use when spray-painting walls/ceiling near built-in shelving or for zero-overspray jobs.
doctrine: Derived from wood_shelving baseline × 1.5 level multiplier (setup 2.25 min/LF = 27 LF/hr, teardown 0.75 min/LF = 80 LF/hr). Obstruction level-independent (1 min/LF = 60 LF/hr). See legacy closet-shelving-protection.js rates for source.
